questions.title: How much do we authorize on a prepaid card?
questions.question: When a customer pays $80 of goods with a prepaid card, do we keep checkout's existing hold of half the goods ($40), or authorize the full $80 with no surcharge?

options.label: Keep the existing half-goods hold
options.clarification: For prepaid cards, authorize half the goods amount (rounded down to the cent), as checkout does today, with no surcharge added.

options.label: Authorize the full goods amount
options.clarification: For prepaid cards, authorize the full goods amount with no surcharge; the existing half-goods hold is discontinued.
